visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black sleeveless top, sits in front of a dark leather sofa. Behind her are bookshelves filled with books and decorative items like a globe. She holds a small white box with 'Secret Mascot' text, smiling broadly while looking at the camera. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. (2) She begins opening a series of blind boxes. Her hands move quickly to tear the plastic and paper packaging, creating small piles of debris on the table in front of her. She displays a small pink oyster figure with a smiling face, holding it close to the camera lens to show its glossy texture. (3) The woman holds up two similar oyster figures, one in each hand, comparing them. One has a slightly more vivid pink color while the other is muted. She rotates them to show the pearlescent finish on the shell. Her facial expressions are highly animated, frequently laughing and squinting her eyes in delight. (4) The camera shows a close-up of several oyster baby figures arranged on a shelf. Some are wearing dresses, others are tucked in shells. The lighting reflects off their smooth, rounded surfaces. The woman's hand enters the frame occasionally to adjust their positions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The female speaker starts with high-pitched, rapid Mandarin greeting, accompanied by a bouncy, high-tempo synthesizer BGM. (2) A crisp tearing sound of plastic is heard, immediately followed by the speaker's sharp intake of breath and an explosive 'Ah!' squeal of delight. (3) A soft rustling of cardboard follows as the next box is opened; an off-screen male voice briefly mumbles a short question with lower pitch. (4) A 'Pop' sound effect triggers as a new figure is revealed, syncopated with the speaker's rhythmic repetition of 'You-ei!' (I got it!) in a rising, excited melody. (5) The BGM continues with a steady electronic beat while the speaker provides rapid-fire comparative commentary, her voice showing high tonal variability and clear articulation.
